blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Financial question answering can fail even when a model extracts a plausible number from the supplied evidence: the answer may attach it to the wrong entity, period, unit, or accounting concept. Asking the model to verify and revise its draft can help, but open-ended revision may alter content that was already correct or inspect the wrong relation and reinforce the original error. We formulate repair as a decision that balances the information it may recover against the correct content it may damage. Based on this trade-off, we introduce Calibrated Answer Repair (CAR), which first estimates whether a draft is likely to benefit from repair, then selects a targeted check, localizes the relevant evidence or draft span, and limits the permitted edit. Across FinRank, Fin-RATE, and FinQA with three open-weight models, CAR outperforms generic verification in all dataset-model settings. At the system level, it recovers 14.6% of initially missed answer requirements while damaging 2.1% of initially correct ones. Its post-draft token cost is over 30 percent lower than the iterative revision alternatives. Ablations on two dataset-model settings show that evidence localization and bounded editing are the main contributors to CAR's gains.
blocks.zh: 即使一个模型从提供的证据中提取出一个可信的数字,财务问题答案也可能失败:答案可能附在错误的实体、时期、单位或会计概念上。 要求模型核实和修改其草案会有所帮助,但开放式修改可能会改变已经正确或检查错误关系的内容,强化原来的错误. 我们制定修复办法是为了在它可能恢复的信息与它可能损坏的正确内容之间保持平衡。 基于这种权衡,我们引入了校准解答修补(CAR),它首先估计草稿是否可能从修理中受益,然后选择有针对性的检查,确定相关证据或草稿的长度,并限制允许的编辑。 通过FinRank、Fin-RATE和FinQA三种开放重量型号,CAR在所有数据集模型设置中都超过了通用验证。 在系统层面,它回收了14.6%最初错过的答案要求,同时损坏了2.1%最初正确的答案要求. 它的草稿后代币成本比迭代修订方案低30%以上. 在两个数据集模型设置上的偏差表明,证据本地化和定界编辑是CAR收益的主要贡献者.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Financial reports rarely present an answer as an isolated number. Even a simple numerical question may require a system to combine narrative
text, tables, and intermediate calculations, and then determine which company,
reporting period, unit, and accounting concept a value describes ( Zhu et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2022 ) . Financial question
answering therefore requires both numerical reasoning and precise grounding in
the supplied evidence. Language models can succeed at finding or computing a
value while failing to ground it correctly: a number may appear in the filing
but belong to a different period or entity. Because related figures
often occur in the same passage or table, the resulting answer can still appear
precise and well supported while expressing the wrong relation ( Mansouri et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Stolfo, 2024 ) .

blocks.en:
A natural response is to ask the model to verify its draft against the evidence
and revise any detected error ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ; Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) .
However, self-verification can
introduce errors of its own ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Kamoi et al., 2024 ) . We explore two main risks:
(1) over-editing , in which the verifier changes correct content while
fixing a local error, and (2) misdirected verification , in which it
checks the wrong relation or evidence and consequently preserves the original
error or adds an irrelevant claim. Reliable repair must therefore decide whether to repair, what to check and where to inspect, and which edit contract to apply .

Motivated by this trade-off, we propose Calibrated Answer Repair ( CAR ). It first estimates whether a draft is likely to benefit from
revision and leaves it unchanged when repair is unlikely to help. If revision

relevant source text or the sentence or calculation in the draft. It then
limits edits to adding supported information or correcting only a confirmed
error, leaving unrelated content unchanged.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Financial QA benchmarks cover a range of evidence structures and reasoning demands. TAT-QA combines numerical reasoning over tables and text, FinQA provides program supervision for multi-step calculations, and ConvFinQA extends financial reasoning to conversational questions ( Zhu et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Chen et al., 2022 ) . FinRank focuses on answer grounding and provenance within released per-question candidate pools containing supporting passages and hard negatives, an emphasis shared by evidence-based QA evaluations of source quality and answer attribution ( Gao et al., 2023b ; Schimanski et al., 2024 ) . It is not a full-filing retrieval setting. Fin-RATE evaluates detailed reasoning, cross-company comparison, and longitudinal analysis over financial filings using benchmark-provided gold context ( Mansouri et al., 2026 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) . Together, these benchmarks span confusable-evidence grounding, multi-document financial analysis, and numerical reasoning.
blocks.zh: 财务质量保证基准涵盖一系列证据结构和推理要求。 TAT-QA将数字推理结合到表格和文本上,FinQA为多步骤计算提供程序监督,ConvFinQA将财务推理扩展到对话问题(Zhu等人,2021年;Chen等人,2021年;Chen等人,2022年). FinRank侧重于在包含支持段落和硬负数的每个问题候选人库中解答定位和出处,这是基于证据的质量保证对来源质量和答案归属的评价的共同重点(Gao等人,2023b;Schimanski等人,2024年)。 这不是一个完整的文件检索设置。 Fin-RATE利用基准提供的黄金背景对财务申报进行详细推理、跨公司比较和纵向分析(Mansouri等人,2026年;Jiang等人,2026年)。 这些基准加在一起涉及可信任的证据基础、多文件财务分析和数字推理。

blocks.en: Existing methods improve generated answers through feedback, evidence gathering, or structured verification. Self-Refine alternates model-generated feedback and revision ( Madaan et al., 2023 ) . Verify-and-Edit and RARR retrieve external evidence before editing reasoning chains or unsupported claims ( Zhao et al., 2023 ; Gao et al., 2023a ) . Chain-of-Verification generates dedicated questions for checking an initial response, while CRITIC incorporates feedback from external tools ( Dhuliawala et al., 2024 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) . Sampling-based methods additionally use agreement or disagreement across generations as a reliability signal ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Manakul et al., 2023 ) . Recent studies also examine the conditions under which models can successfully correct their own outputs ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Kamoi et al., 2024 ) . Building on this literature, CAR treats verification as a selective repair process that jointly determines whether to edit, what relation to check, and how much of the draft to change.
blocks.zh: 现有方法通过反馈、证据收集或结构化核查改进了生成的答案。 自注释替代模型生成的反馈和修订(Madaan等人,2023年). 校验-编辑和RAR在编辑推理链或不支持索赔之前检索外部证据(Zhao等人,2023年;Gao等人,2023年a). 校验链产生专门的问题,用于检查初步答复,而CRITIC吸收了外部工具的反馈(Dhuliawala等人,2024年;Gou等人,2024年). 采样方法还多用不同世代的协议或分歧作为可靠性信号(Wang等人,2023年;Manakul等人,2023年). 近期的研究还研究了模型能够成功校正自身产出的条件(Huang等人,2024年;Kamoi等人,2024年)。 在文献的基础上,CAR将核查视为一种选择性的修复过程,共同决定是否编辑,与检查有什么关系,以及草案要修改多少.

blocks.en: Selective prediction allows a system to abstain when its confidence is insufficient, while model cascades allocate additional computation to selected examples ( Geifman and El-Yaniv, 2017 ; Kamath et al., 2020 ; Varshney and Baral, 2022 ) . These approaches motivate using additional computation only where it is likely to improve the output. CAR applies this principle after an answer has been generated, choosing between preserving the draft and invoking repair. Fine-grained evaluation provides a complementary perspective: FActScore decomposes long-form outputs into atomic claims so that supported and unsupported content can be assessed separately ( Min et al., 2023 ) . We similarly assess answer requirements before and after repair, distinguishing recovered requirements from regressions that aggregate answer accuracy can obscure.
blocks.zh: 选择性预测允许一个系统在信心不足时弃权,而模型级联则将额外计算分配给选定的实例(Geifman和El-Yaniv,2017年;Kamath等人,2020年;Varshney和Baral,2022年)。 只有在有可能改进产出的情况下,这些方法才鼓励采用额外的计算。 中非共和国在得到答复后适用这一原则,在保留草案和援引修理之间作出选择。 精细评价提供了一个补充视角:FActScore将长式输出分解为原子主张,以便支持和不支持的内容可以分别评估(Min等人,2023年). 我们同样评估修复前和修复后的答复要求,区分收回的要求和总答复准确性可能模糊的回归。

blocks.en: 5.1 Benchmarks and Primary Metrics

blocks.en:
Our evaluation covers three financial question-answering benchmarks with
complementary evidence and reasoning demands: • FinRank ( Mansouri et al., 2026 ) evaluates answer grounding and provenance over per-question evidence. We report Grounded Answer Accuracy (GAA) , which counts an answer as correct only when its content is correct and at least one returned passage identifier belongs to the gold support set. This joint criterion measures both answer quality and evidence attribution, rather than passage ranking alone. • Fin-RATE ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) covers detailed reasoning (DR-QA), cross-company comparison (EC-QA), and longitudinal tracking (LT-QA). We use its gold-context setting, giving every method the same benchmark-provided supporting context. The official evaluator assigns each answer one of four labels—Correct, Partial, Incorrect, or Failure. Correctness Rate (CR) is the percentage labeled Correct, and we report it by subtask and use their unweighted mean as a summary. • FinQA ( Chen et al., 2021 ) tests numerical reasoning over financial text and tables. We report Numerical Answer Accuracy (NAA) , the proportion of normalized final answers that match the gold execution result. NAA directly evaluates the requested numerical result without requiring a generated program.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: CAR makes repair selective, targeted, and bounded. It outperforms standard verification approaches in all nine benchmark–model settings and stronger verification variants in eight. Its post-draft token cost is higher than a single verification pass but lower than the iterative revision alternatives. Controlled ablations show that evidence localization and bounded edits matter across both judge-based and numerical-answer evaluation, while the fixed-checklist gap is small on FinQA.
blocks.zh: 汽车制造有选择性、有针对性和有界限的修理。 它在所有9个基准模式中都超过了标准核查方法,在8个基准模式中则超过了更强大的核查变体。 它的草稿后代号费用高于单一的核查通行证,但低于迭代订正办法。 受控盘点显示,证据本地化和定界编辑在基于法官和数字答案的评价中都具有重要性,而FinQA上的固定盘点清单差距很小。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our evaluation covers three English-language financial benchmarks and three open-weight models. Results may not transfer directly to other domains, languages, or model families, and the calibrated repair policy relies on paired development outcomes. Fin-RATE uses benchmark-provided gold context, so our experiments focus on answer repair rather than end-to-end retrieval. Requirement-level outcomes use an independent judge, while benchmark metrics and a blinded audit provide complementary checks.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价包括三个英文财务基准和三个开放加权模式。 成果可能不会直接转移到其他领域、语言或模范家庭,而校准的修复政策依赖于配对的发展成果。 Fin-RATE使用基准提供的黄金上下文,因此我们的实验侧重于答案修复而不是端到端的检索. 要求一级的结果使用独立法官,而基准衡量标准和盲目审计则提供补充检查。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Higher requirement coverage does not make a financial answer safe for investment, accounting, or regulatory use. Deployed systems should expose their evidence, avoid unsupported repairs, and retain qualified human review for consequential decisions.
blocks.zh: 更高的要求范围不能使财务解决办法安全地用于投资、会计或管理。 部署的系统应披露其证据,避免无根据的修理,并保留合格的人力审查,以便作出相应的决定。

blocks.en: The benchmarks are based on public financial disclosures, but redistribution remains subject to the corresponding dataset licenses. Failure annotation, calibration, and repeated model inference also incur compute and data-transfer costs.
blocks.zh: 这些基准是基于公开的财务披露,但再分配仍然取决于相应的数据集许可证。 失败的注释、校准和重复的模型推论也会产生计算和数据传输费用。

blocks.en: Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501 are served with vLLM and their official chat templates in BF16 with a 32,768-token context. The Qwen models use non-thinking mode. Draft , probe, verification, and repair calls use deterministic decoding ( T = 0 T=0 ), while each SC-Verify run uses three independently seeded samples ( T = 0.7 T=0.7 , top- p = 0.95 p=0.95 ). Within each dataset–model setting, the same pinned checkpoint generates the draft and handles subsequent verification calls. Maximum new-token limits are 512 for draft generation, 256 for the probe, and 384 for repair. The append contract allows at most 80 new tokens. Local replacement allows at most two spans covering no more than 20% of the draft tokens. The run manifest records checkpoint and tokenizer SHAs, software and dataset versions, split question identifiers, generation and bootstrap seeds, and hardware inventory.

blocks.en: E.4 Checks, Pointers, and Validation
blocks.zh: E.4 检查、指针和验证

blocks.en: Each check names a relation and an evidence-inspection procedure. Representative checks trace a figure to its entity, match a quantity to its reporting period, verify an accounting-concept binding, confirm direct evidence support, or recompute an operation from cited inputs and units. Checks are phrased as questions to resolve rather than assertions that an error exists.
blocks.zh: 每个检查姓名 关系和证据检查程序。 代表检查将一个数字追踪到实体,与报告期间的数量相匹配,核实一个会计概念具有约束力,确认直接证据支持,或从所引述的投入和单位重算一项业务。 检查是用来解决问题而不是断言存在错误。

blocks.en: For an omission, the pointer gives the IDs of the highest-ranked source passages. For suspected wrong content, it identifies the least-supported draft sentence and its best-matching passage ID. In short numerical contexts, it marks the relevant expression or calculation span. Passage text is not copied into the pointer: the verifier sees each shared evidence block only once. The family scores accompany the pointer as coarse guidance.
blocks.zh: 对于省略,指针给出了排名最高的源段落的ID. 对于疑似错误的内容,它会识别支持最少的句子草稿及其最匹配的通过ID. 在简短的数字语境中,它标志着相关的表达或计算跨度. 通过文本不复制到指针中:核查者只看到每个共享的证据块一次. 家族的分数跟随指针作为粗糙的指导.

blocks.en: The append policy permits a supported addition without deleting the draft. The local-replacement policy permits substitution only within a specified span. Both policies limit output length and require the model to cite the evidence used for the edit. Append is not assumed to be semantically risk-free: a contradictory addition either fails validation or is counted as damage during evaluation.
blocks.zh: 附件政策允许在不删除草案的情况下添加支持的内容。 地方替代政策只允许在规定的时间内进行替代。 这两项政策都限制产出长度,并要求模型引用编辑所用的证据. 附录不假定是无风险的:相互矛盾的添加要么失败验证,要么在评估中算作损害。

blocks.en: The repair call returns a list of records containing the edit type, the source span for a replacement, the proposed text, and a supporting-passage identifier. The validator locates replacement spans first by exact match and then after canonicalizing quotation marks, emphasis, and whitespace. It processes edits in response order and rejects a replacement if its source span cannot be located or overlaps an accepted edit. A parsing failure, unsupported evidence identifier, or empty valid-edit set returns the original draft.
blocks.zh: 修补调用返回包含编辑类型、替换源跨度、拟议文本和辅助通道标识符的记录清单。 校验器定位替换的间隔首先是精确匹配,然后是标出引号、强调和空白。 它按响应顺序处理编辑,拒绝替换,如果其源跨不能找到或重叠一个接受的编辑. 一个解析失败, 不支持的证据标识符, 或空的有效编辑设置返回原始草稿 。

blocks.en: F.2 FinQA Component Ablation

blocks.en: We repeat the four one-factor ablations on FinQA with Mistral-24B. The 1,147-question test split provides a larger numerical evaluation in a different model family. Numerical Answer Accuracy (NAA) directly checks the requested result. Each variant changes one component. Always repair still runs the probe but forces the gate open. No pointer removes only the localization cue while retaining the full evidence pool. Fixed checklist replaces question-specific check selection. Unbounded rewrite retains the other checks and pointer but removes the edit-scope limit.

blocks.en: F.3 FinQA Normalization and Input Audit
blocks.zh: F.3 FinQA 正常化和投入审计

blocks.en: The model input contains the released pre_text , linearized table, and post_text , and each field is capped at 4,500 characters. The released gold_inds are evaluation metadata and are excluded from model prompts. We strip currency symbols and thousands separators, normalize percentages to the scale implied by the reference answer, and accept an absolute tolerance of 10 − 4 10^{-4} after normalization. Answers containing two unresolved competing final values are marked incorrect.
blocks.zh: 模型输入包含已发布的前_文本,线性化表格,以及后_文本,每个字段封顶为4500个字符. 释放的gold_inds是评价元数据,被排除在模型提示之外. 我们剥离货币符号和数千个分隔符,与参考答案所隐含的尺度成正比,并在正常化后接受10 - 4 10 - 4 - 4的绝对容忍度。 包含两个未解决的竞合最终值的答案是明显不正确的.

blocks.en: In a manual audit of 300 FinQA questions, 289 (96.3%) retained all answer-bearing content, although 25 (8.3%) had at least one input field truncated by the 4,500-character cap. These categories are not mutually exclusive.
blocks.zh: 在对300个FinQA问题进行的人工审计中,289(96.3%)保留了所有有答案的内容,尽管25(8.3%)至少有一个输入字段被4,500字符上限截断。 这些类别并非相互排斥。

blocks.en: F.4 FinRank Evidence Pool
blocks.zh: F.4 芬朗证据库

blocks.en: FinRank’s released supporting passages and curated hard negatives are shuffled before inference. The resulting per-question candidate pool contains a median of 7 passages (range 5–12). GAA jointly evaluates answer correctness and provenance: a response must be correct and return a passage identifier in the gold support set. This generation-oriented metric is distinct from FinRank’s original ranking metric.
blocks.zh: FinRank发布支持段落及整理硬底片, 由此产生的每个问题候选人人才库包含7个段落的中位数(范围为5至12段)。 GAA联合评价答案正确性和出处:回复必须正确,并返回黄金支持集中的段落标识符. 这个面向一代的度量衡不同于芬蘭克最初的排名度量衡.
